title.narrative: Expansion of the Power Transmission and Distribution Systems Project

description.narrative:
The overall objectives of the Project are: to contribute to the improvement of the welfare level and living conditions of the population of Suriname; and contribute to the competitiveness of the domestic producers and exporters. The specific Project purpose is: Expanded power transmission capacity in Paramaribo and also distribution capacity in Nickerie, at lower recovery costs as well as increasing reliability for transmission in both systems.
The project will contribute towards improving the living conditions of the population, catalyze the sustained economic growth of the country by meeting the growing demand in the two main interconnected electricity grids of Suriname, and achieve electricity grid enhancement by improving electricity supply.
The project will reinforce the electricity infrastructure by upgrading transmission and distribution system, which contributes to achieve SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure). In addition, the Bank’s intervention will help Suriname towards achieving SDG 7 (Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all).
